Please Try Again. Powered by Reelgood Last week’s all-new episode of The Pitt ended with two of the HBO Max show’s most beloved nurses in trouble. Jesse (Ned Brower) was arrested by ICE officers after he tried to physically shield an injured detainee from being assaulted, while Emma (Laëtitia Hollard) found herself attacked by patient Curtis Larson (Travis Van Winkle). Will Jesse be okay? Will someone come to Emma’s rescue? The Pitt Season 2 takes place over a super chaotic Fourth of July shift in the ED. Dr. Robby (Noah Wyle) is trying to make it through his last day at work before a long sabbatical, Dr. Langdon (Patrick Ball) is attempting to survive his first day back from rehab, and the whole emergency department is juggling outrageous holiday injuries with an internet shutdown. (Other hospitals in the area have been closed by cyberattacks and the Pitt’s admins are trying to proactively defend against the same.) There are only four episodes left in The Pitt‘s second season. Will Robby and his staff manage to ever get a break? Will fan favorite docs from the night shift begin rolling in? What’s going to happen next on The Pitt? Here’s everything you need to know to watch the next episode of The Pitt on HBO Max… Photo: HBO Max When Does The Next Episode of The Pitt Come Out? The Pitt Season 2 Episode 12 “6 PM” Release Date: The Pitt Season 2 Episode 12 “6 PM” will premiere on HBO MAX on Thursday, March 26. What Time Is The Pitt On Tonight? The Pitt Season 2 Episode 12 “6 PM” will be streaming tonight, Thursday, March 26, at 9 PM ET (or 6 PM PT) on HBO MAX. Most new episodes of HBO MAX originals now hit the streaming service at 9 PM ET/6 PM PT. Photo: HBO Max How Many Episodes Are in The Pitt? The Pitt Season 2 Episode Guide: There are fifteen episodes in The Pitt Season 2. New episodes of The Pitt come out on Thursdays between now and April 16. Here’s your guide to when every episode of The Pitt Season 2 is coming out: Season 2 Episode 1 “7 AM”: Thursday, January 8, 9 PM ET Season 2 Episode 2 “8 AM”: Thursday, January 15, 9 PM ET Season 2 Episode 3 “9 AM”: Thursday, January 22, 9 PM ET Season 2 Episode 4 “10 AM”: Thursday, January 29, 9 PM ET Season 2 Episode 5 “11 AM”: Thursday, February 5, 9 PM ET Season 2 Episode 6 “12 PM”: Thursday, February 12, 9 PM ET Season 2 Episode 7 “1 PM”: Thursday, February 19, 9 PM ET Season 2 Episode 8 “2 PM”: Thursday, February 26, 9 PM ET Season 2 Episode 9 “3 PM”: Thursday, March 5, 9 PM ET Season 2 Episode 10 “4 PM”: Thursday, March 12, 9 PM ET Season 2 Episode 11 “5 PM”: Thursday, March 19, 9 PM ET Season 2 Episode 12 “6 PM”: Thursday, March 26, 9 PM ET Season 2 Episode 13 “7 PM”: Thursday, April 2, 9 PM ET Season 2 Episode 14 “8 PM”: Thursday, April 9, 9 PM ET Season 2 Episode 15 “9 PM”: Thursday, April 16, 9 PM ET Photo: HBO Max Is There Going to Be a The Pitt Season 3? Good news! HBO Max has already renewed The Pitt for a third season. The Pitt Season 3 should come out in January 2027. Is There a Trailer for The Pitt Season 2? Yes, there is! You can watch The Pitt Season 2 trailer by scrolling to the top of this page. The Pitt Season 2 Cast Guide: HBO Max’s The Pitt features a massive ensemble cast of actors, some of whom you might already know from projects like ER, Imposters, The L Word, Chucky, Catch-22, The Gilded Age, or Star Trek: Picard.
